source: Dutton et al. 2011, SWELLS II, https://arxiv.org/abs/1101.1622
rotation_source: Table 4; observed H-alpha + [N II] velocities, not deprojected circular velocities
photometry_source: Table 2 SPS masses (Chabrier IMF); Table 3 chameleon shape parameters; Sections 2, 3, 6
gas_note: No resolved gas mass map supplied by this paper. The default pilot omits cold gas, as in its initial mass model. This is an assumption, not a measured zero.
distance_note: Recompute all angular-diameter distances from the stated cosmology. This gives 2.437736 kpc/arcsec, consistent with Section 2 and Table 4. The three distances printed in Section 4.4 are internally inconsistent with that scale and are not mixed into the calculation.
